modmenu.descriptionTranslation.lazycraft: A collection of quality-of-life crafting features to make crafting feel intuitive.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.title: LazyCraft
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.recipeB: Enables LazyCraft's additional recipe-book click actions.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.recursi: Allows ghost recipes to craft their missing crafting-table dependencies.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.backgro: Additional delay after each non-visible recipe check. The first background check is immediate, and visible recipes are always prioritized. Higher values reduce sustained background CPU usage; 20 ticks is normally one second.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.recursi: Maximum number of dependency levels searched for recursive crafting plans.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.maxCand: Maximum candidate plans kept at each search layer. Higher values may find more or better plans, but use more time and memory.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.serverU: How long LazyCraft waits for a server menu update before cancelling. Twenty ticks is normally one second.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.stepDel: Delay between completed dependency steps. Increase this only if a laggy server updates inventories too slowly.
text.lazycraft.scoring_mode.least_total_: Uses the fewest ingredient units across the whole plan.
text.lazycraft.scoring_mode.fewest_steps: Uses the fewest distinct crafting steps.
text.lazycraft.scoring_mode.fewest_recip: Runs recipes the fewest total times.
Tie-breakers: fewer ingredients, then fewer steps.
text.lazycraft.scoring_mode.fastest_exec: Runs recipes fewer times, then minimizes the number of steps.
text.lazycraft.scoring_mode.inventory_fi: Crafts the fewest missing intermediate ingredient units.
text.lazycraft.scoring_mode.shallowest_c: Uses the shortest recursive dependency chain.
text.lazycraft.scoring_mode.least_base_i: Consumes the fewest items present when planning began.
Tie-breakers: batch surplus, executions, then steps.
text.lazycraft.scoring_mode.least_overpr: Creates the least surplus caused by recipe batch sizes.
